name: Cegléd (Hungary)
description: A vertical blue banner charged at the centre with the town arms of Cegléd (a blue shield with a yellow lion within a yellow frame) above the name CEGLÉD in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Cegléd arms in a yellow frame
